scope: sections, regions, notes and complex fields
implemented: per-section headers survive the WPS \sectd\sect ordering: the reset is deferred past the following \sect, so a section commits the header/footer and geometry it accumulated instead of losing them; 072 now writes 40 header references (was 1) and the header renders on every section's pages

\chpgn and \sectnum are kept as dynamic PAGE/SECTION fields instead of unknown controls; the renderer's page-dependent field pass computes them, so 072's headers read 'Ruth (Page 2)' (was 'Ruth (Page )'); 072 import losses 42 -> 2

bookmarks are preserved: {\*\bkmkstart Name}/{\*\bkmkend Name} become paired w:bookmarkStart/w:bookmarkEnd with a shared decimal w:id and the name (616 occurrences across 7 corpus docs were dropped, losing every anchor a hyperlink or REF field targets)

first/even-page headers render: \titlepg maps to the section's w:titlePg and an even \headerl/\footerl region sets w:evenAndOddHeaders (002 now writes 7 w:titlePg and even/default header references; both were dropped before)
section columns are preserved: \cols -> w:cols/@num, \colsx -> @space, \colno/\colw/\colsr -> the per-column w:col specs with equalWidth cleared (074/092 now carry their 2-column definitions)
\rtlsect/\ltrsect set the section bidi flag (\rtlpar/\ltrpar were already mapped)

footnote/endnote numbering and placement map to NoteProperties: document-wide \ftn*/\enddoc and \aftn*/\aenddoc land in settings.xml (w:footnotePr/w:endnotePr), and the section-scoped \sftn*/\saftn* forms land in the running w:sectPr. Number formats (\ftnnar/alc/auc/rlc/ruc/chi and endnote twins), \ftnstart/\aftnstart (w:numStart), \ftnrstcont/\ftnrestart/\ftnrstpg and \aftnrstcont/\aftnrestart (w:numRestart), and position (\ftnbj->pageBottom, \ftntj->beneathText, \endnotes->sectEnd, \enddoc->docEnd, \aendnotes->sectEnd, \aenddoc->docEnd) are mapped per the RTF 1.5 footnotes table; 29 corpus documents lose 625 import-loss events. \aftnbj/\aftntj and \ftnlytwnine stay Loss (no ST_EdnPos value / no Strict equivalent). Note separators (\ftnsep/\ftnsepc/\ftncn and endnote twins) remain Loss: faithful w:separator content needs a shared RunContent::Separator, not a hidden fragment.
remaining: 072 remaining +34 pages is a WPS source-format inconsistency, not a mapping bug. Body line pitch matches (16.1pt = Arimo 1.15em x \sl280/240). The residual is inter-paragraph spacing: measured against the immutable WPS references, the WPS RTF path SUMS before+after (072 heading->heading 38.25pt = sum 36pt) while the WPS DOCX path takes MAX (06-strict-math-display body->Heading2 14.74pt = max 14pt). The renderer's max (paginate.rs) is what the DOCX baseline and the SVG refs require; a max->sum change regressed 06 and was reverted, and inflating w:before at import would misrepresent the document. Recorded as a WPS RTF-path quirk (not imitated, not a support blocker).
w:contextualSpacing is unimplemented in the renderer (a real gap; neither witness above uses it)
section column LAYOUT is not implemented in the shared renderer: w:cols round-trips and validates, but a multi-column section still renders as one column (a shared layout build)

note placement/numbering is mapped for the controls the corpus and RTF 1.5 define; note SEPARATOR definitions (\ftnsep/\ftnsepc/\ftncn, \aftnsep/\aftnsepc/\aftncn) are still dropped as destination Loss because the shared model has no RunContent::Separator and the reader currently discards w:separator; mapping them faithfully needs that shared addition rather than an empty placeholder note
multi-paragraph field block results (a shared model change) and custom marks are unreviewed

field-instruction-control:* (~40k events) are formatting controls inside \fldinst; correctly kept out of the instruction text but reported as Loss, reclassification open (blanket rename forbidden by the plan)
